title: Listing intelligence v1: price-change alert on every observed change, and promotion late-activation / early-deactivation detection (spec section 9.6)
acceptance_criteria: Every observed price change on a registered listing creates one alert row (not only first-versus-latest), visible on Market & Listings and in the notification inbox

For an active CPOR case, an observed price above the funded price after the window start lands on a worklist as late activation; a return to the normal price before the window end lands as early deactivation
Alerts are derived from listing_observation history; nothing is invented when observations are missing, and a gap is shown as a gap
The planned/partial labels on Market & Listings for these panels are removed only when the panel is real
Tests green on touched areas, tsc exit 0, eslint clean on changed files
